0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, with the Raptors hosting the Bulls. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Nate Bittle is day-to-day with a foot injury, while Chicago is missing Dailyn Swain and Jordan Hawkins, who are both out with illness, and Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury, with Isaac Okoro, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins listed as day-to-day. Toronto won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 139-109 win in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
